title: 连接禾芽家庭教务
description: 输入禾芽设置页中的家庭专属 Token。凭证只保存在 WorkBuddy 本机，用于访问该 Token 对应家庭的数据。
description_en: Enter the family token from Heyah Settings. It is stored locally by WorkBuddy and only grants access to the linked family.
